authority: GM private forward-story canon. Respects existing player approvals, clinical pact canon, established observed in-game evidence; changes only previously UNDECIDED culprit and intent. Not player knowledge. Plot belongs exclusively to ONE Utsuro secondary arc and should be closed without time skips in few beats.

culprit.role: Пропавший заведующий переплётной мастерской, контролировавший ключи, старую матрицу и передачу свитков
culprit.name: Тамура Гэндзо
culprit.loyalty: Заработок и личное убеждение, что он обязан пробудить древний больничный договор; никакой доказанной связи с основными V-7, Нори, Суга, Кабуто и самостоятельным главным сюжетом.
culprit.knowledge: Years earlier restored fragments of confiscated old medical archive and saw references to Реестр невыписанных, old ward and 'call a doctor'; knows genuine forbidden scroll is trap that binds whoever signs blood, does not know full physiology of Utsuro or patient. No mindreading, clairvoyance, knowledge of secret Shiki genome.
culprit.motive: Desperate, morally culpable attempt to obtain ANY living blood-contract respondent who could call the ward or find a physician, to alleviate/protect a woman kept in failing ward and to relieve own guilt for a past archive containment mistake. Not acting by direct orders of Utsuro or the patient; no established face-to-face bond with them. Intentionally forces involuntary covenant on uninformed victim and hides evidence. He would have continued even if victim were not doctor.

mechanism.pre_0630: Before day staff start, Gendzo dressed as masked repair courier and showed a forged internal work authorization. Guard Izumi opened old transfer channel; Gendzo withdrew the legitimate commonly requested A-117 summon scroll and left it tucked away in the disused channel (where Shiki eventually recovered it). He planted gray bone-clasp ward contract in the A-117 teaching tray, a bait for the FIRST permitted reader; no one yet knew Shiki specifically would be that first reader. Old damaged office seal matrix was available to him in bindery.
mechanism.post_bond_forgery: After discovering that Shiki's accidental blood signed the contract, Gendzo tried to mislead inquiry and suggest that Shiki's request existed before the day shift. He retrospectively wrote BOTH apparent 05:54 preparatory requisition (3 scrolls named Shiki) and 06:11 issue record, using his own hand and obsolete damaged stamp. THOSE ARE BACKDATED LEDGER TIMES, not independent authenticated times of writing. His writing 'МУГАМИ ШИКИ' on reverse of cut night-seal page was part of forging/identifying the exploited summoner after the fact. This reconciles player's assertion 'nobody knew my archive plan' with misleading paper timestamps. If independent forensic chronology later contradicts this, player-established later canon overrides.
mechanism.disappearance: Gendzo left the bindery soon after learning Sekido was comparing stamps; he is in hiding nearby to avoid prosecution, neither automatically murdered nor leading a broader underground network. Findable through standard investigation and/or trace on his old mechanical receipt, no further conspirator required.
mechanism.guard: Izumi knowingly opened transfer at masked holder's presented authorization but did not knowingly intend blood pact; concealed irregular transaction in fear of disciplinary investigation, admitted when shown evidence. His culpability is negligence/false testimony, not proven co-conspirator.
mechanism.utsuro: Utsuro did NOT arrange or command the swap. His need for outside physician was real; he cannot teleport contracts into Kusa shelves from inside seven seals. His unease and human origin do not prove culpability.
mechanism.patient: The ward woman did NOT plant the scroll; her voice through remote seal does not constitute physically arranging a modern archive swap.

near_resolution_beat: As Sekido traces actual repair register and binds together ink-drying sequence, timestamps exposed as backdated, then Tamura located and confronted (not must be by Shiki; he may be arrested offscreen with report). Brief confrontation, choice and consequence. No more successive suspects or third investigation arc. Medical woman's immediate acute problem can resolve with separate nourishment from forced motor signals (only with woman's informed consent and Shiki involvement as voluntarily chosen), not instant full tissue regrowth. Afterwards Utsuro remains background world NPC with pact ongoing; main story resumes.
discovery_protocol: Do not instantly reveal Gendzo, motive or retroactive entries as OBJECTIVE in-character while only Sekido suspects. Present independent forensic signs in logical sequence, permit alternate player interventions. If user explicitly asks OOC about GM plotting, truth can be discussed openly, but label it as newly fixed now rather than claimed as long-standing plan.
date_and_timing_note: Earlier GM wrote 05:54 and 06:11 as registry records, never established via independent timestamp forensic examination that ink was applied at those exact times. New truth exploits that distinction; no retroactive modification of spoken dialogue is required.
